name: Crisugabalin
summary: Crisugabalin (HSK16149) is a novel GABA analog in development for the treatment of chronic pain. It has a wider therapeutic index than pregabalin, which has a similar mechanism of action. In China, it was approved in May 2024 for the treatment of diabetic peripheral neuropathy with neuropathic pain and approved in July 2024 for the treatment of postherpetic neuralgia.

pharmacology.text: It has a wider therapeutic index than pregabalin, which has a similar mechanism of action.

uses.text: Crisugabalin (HSK16149) is a novel GABA analog in development for the treatment of chronic pain. In China, it was approved in May 2024 for the treatment of diabetic peripheral neuropathy with neuropathic pain and approved in July 2024 for the treatment of postherpetic neuralgia.

summaryZh: 克利加巴林，商品名思美寧，是一種選擇性GABA類似物，正在開發用於治療慢性疼痛。它的治療指數比作用機制相似的普瑞巴林更廣。該藥物由海思科醫藥集團研發，於2024年5月在中國大陸獲批用於治療糖尿病性周圍神經病理性疼痛，7月獲批第二個適應症帶狀疱疹後神經痛。在美國，該藥物已於2023年進入III期臨床試驗階段。

sideEffects.en: Little is known beyond clinical trials. Drugs of its class, the gabapentinoids, commonly cause dizziness, sleepiness, unsteadiness, swelling and weight gain. They can be misused and lead to dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 臨床試驗以外的資料很少。同類的加巴噴丁類藥物常見作用有頭暈、嗜睡、步態不穩、水腫與體重增加。它們可能被濫用並導致依賴，突然停藥可能出現戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 临床试验以外的数据很少。同类的加巴喷丁类药物常见作用有头晕、嗜睡、步态不稳、水肿与体重增加。它们可能被滥用并导致依赖，突然停药可能出现戒断反应。

fact.en: Like pregabalin and gabapentin, it binds to the alpha-2-delta part of nerve calcium channels. Gabapentin, the first of this family, was designed to mimic GABA but turned out not to act on GABA receptors at all.
fact.zh: 和普瑞巴林、加巴噴丁一樣，它會結合神經鈣離子通道上的 α2δ 次單元。這個家族的第一個成員加巴噴丁原本是設計來模仿 GABA，結果卻完全不作用於 GABA 受體。
fact.zhHans: 和普瑞巴林、加巴喷丁一样，它会结合神经钙离子信道上的 α2δ 次单元。这个家族的第一个成员加巴喷丁原本是设计来模仿 GABA，结果却完全不作用于 GABA 受体。
